dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Concave spline curve trailing from the apex to the posterior dorsal ridge.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Rounded morphology with a medium pixel radius.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45-degree inclination relative to the horizontal body plane.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.5:1 ratio of base width to vertical height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Broad, convex arc with a large radius relative to the cranial height.
anterior_cranial_contour.rostrum_aspect_vector: Short and thick rostrum protruding from the anterior base of the melon.
anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse angle visible at the transition point between the melon slope and the dorsal rostrum surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Several light-colored circular markings visible on the dorsal surface posterior to the blowhole and on the mid-lateral flank.
other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced monochromatic teal/cyan spectral profile across the entire visible surface.
